operations.label: Cold process startup to usable shell
operations.scope: Fresh macOS profile process to actual shell bootstrap and completed raster frame, with a fresh isolated Madar preferences database. Compilation and installation excluded. OS caches uncontrolled.

operations.label: Switch route and render (ViewModel)
operations.scope: Actual shell ViewModel alternates Inventory/Sales, commits isolated device preferences, then completes the next raster frame. Does not measure pointer or keyboard input dispatch.

operations.label: Save six shortcuts and render (ViewModel)
operations.scope: Actual shell ViewModel edits all six slots, persists two alternating layouts through isolated Madar storage, verifies acknowledgement and completes the next raster frame. Excludes opening/closing the editor or native input dispatch.

operations.label: Process an order
operations.reason: Order processing is not implemented in the Flutter app. Requires an approved real workflow, isolated fixture and separate benchmark before measurement.

operations.label: Add a catalog item
operations.reason: Catalog creation is not implemented. Requires an approved real create/persist workflow and isolated fixture.

operations.label: Add an item to a sale
operations.reason: Sales posting/cart business workflow is not implemented. Existing presentation/toast is not a sales benchmark.

operations.label: Reopen accounts and render
operations.scope: Actual consumer ViewModel/repository command over a fresh real adapter fixture, through AccountsSurface raster completion. Small10/medium1000/largest near20MiB synthetic cash transactions; workspace active+40held. Elapsed excludes reset; sampled RAM/CPU host window includes between-sample reset/cleanup. No native input dispatch or production records.
operations.verification: Independent consumer source review and four real-adapter/consumer scenario conformance tests passed against reviewed engine ea9c21adfde746c40d0e8d15a7e5bbe017beb70c; native/profile outcomes recorded separately. Ready means measurable implementation, not a completed performance result.
